questions.prompt: Why is storing derived state via `useEffect(() => setFullName(`${first} ${last}`), [first, last])` an anti-pattern?

options.text: It causes an extra unnecessary render with stale `fullName` first; compute `const fullName = ...` during render

questions.prompt: What causes a hydration mismatch warning in Server-Side Rendered (SSR) React apps?

options.text: The initial client render produces different HTML/text than the server HTML (e.g., `Date.now()` or `window.innerWidth` during render)

questions.prompt: What is the main risk of putting a single giant `AppContext` holding both `user`, `theme`, and rapidly changing `mousePos` at the root?

options.text: Every component reading `AppContext` re-renders whenever `mousePos` changes, even if it only uses `theme`

questions.prompt: Match each React rendering strategy to its trade-off.

columns.label: Simple static hosting, but initial content waits for JS bundle
Fresh HTML per request and good SEO, at higher server compute cost
Fastest CDN delivery for content that changes infrequently

questions.prompt: When should you reach for `useMemo` or `useCallback` in production React code?

options.text: On every single variable and function by default
When profiling shows an expensive calculation or when passing props to `React.memo` children / effect dependencies

questions.prompt: Select all practices that prevent memory leaks and race conditions in React components. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Removing `window`/`document` event listeners and clearing timers in cleanup
Unsubscribing from WebSocket or store subscriptions on unmount
Leaving `setInterval` running after unmount so data stays warm

questions.prompt: Why is `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: userBio }}` dangerous without sanitization?

options.text: It exposes the app to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) if `userBio` contains malicious `<script>` or event handlers

questions.prompt: What is the benefit of `useSyncExternalStore` when integrating a non-React external store?

options.text: It guarantees tear-free reads during concurrent rendering and supports SSR snapshots
It persists the store to IndexedDB

questions.prompt: How does `children` composition (`<Layout sidebar={<Sidebar />}><Main /></Layout>`) optimize re-renders compared to calling `<Main />` inside `Layout`?

options.text: When `Layout`'s own state changes, the `children` element created by the parent keeps the same reference and skips re-rendering
It turns `Main` into a Web Worker

questions.prompt: Why should clickable actions use `<button type="button">` instead of `<div onClick={...}>`?

options.text: `<button>` provides built-in keyboard activation (`Enter`/`Space`), focusability, and screen-reader role

questions.prompt: Select all practices that keep React Testing Library tests resilient to refactoring. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Query elements by accessible role, label, or visible text (`getByRole`, `getByLabelText`)
Assert visible UI outcomes rather than internal state or private hook details
Assert exact internal component instance properties and CSS class hashes

questions.prompt: What problem does route-based code splitting (`React.lazy` per route) solve?

options.text: Reduces initial JavaScript download and parse/execution time on first load

questions.prompt: In a React app, what causes a 'waterfall' of network requests?

options.text: Rendering a parent that fetches data, waits to mount a child, which then starts its own fetch

questions.prompt: What does `flushSync` from `react-dom` do, and why should it be used sparingly?

options.text: Forces React to flush state updates to the DOM synchronously, bypassing batching and hurting performance if overused

questions.prompt: Match each Core Web Vital to what a React engineering team optimizes to improve it.

columns.label: Smaller initial JS bundle, SSR/SSG, prioritized hero image
Splitting heavy renders, `useTransition`, avoiding main-thread blocks
Reserving explicit dimensions for images, skeletons, and async slots

questions.prompt: Why does passing an inline function `() => setOpen(true)` to a normal `<button>` NOT cause a performance problem by itself?

options.text: Inline functions are cached by V8
Allocating a small closure is cheap; it only matters if passed to a `React.memo` child or an effect's dependency array

questions.prompt: What is a common bug when using `useEffect` to sync React state with `localStorage` in multiple tabs?

options.text: Not listening to the `window` `'storage'` event or not handling JSON parse failures with `try/catch`

questions.prompt: What does this pattern achieve when building a reusable component library?

options.text: Forwards extra standard DOM props (`disabled`, `aria-*`, `className`) to the underlying element

questions.prompt: Select all valid reasons to use an Error Boundary around independent dashboard widgets. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Error Boundaries automatically catch rejected `fetch` Promises without `try/catch`
A crash in one chart widget does not take down the entire page
Each widget boundary can display a localized retry/fallback UI
Errors can be reported to telemetry in `componentDidCatch`

questions.prompt: When rendering a list of 10,000 rows in React, what is the most effective optimization?

options.text: List virtualization/windowing so only visible rows are mounted in the DOM

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` (`rules-of-hooks` and `exhaustive-deps`)?

options.text: Enforcing Hook call rules and catching missing dependencies that cause stale closures

questions.prompt: Why should you avoid suppressing `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` with `// eslint-disable-next-line` unless truly justified?

options.text: Missing dependencies usually cause the effect to read stale props/state on future updates

questions.prompt: Match each React state management scope to the appropriate tool.

rows.label: Single component UI state (modal open, input)
Cached remote API data with refetching

questions.prompt: Why is storing server API responses in a dedicated server-state cache better than `useEffect` + global Redux/Context for most apps?

options.text: Server-state libraries handle deduplication, stale-while-revalidate, retries, and cache invalidation automatically
Redux cannot run in the browser

questions.prompt: What happens in React 18+ automatic batching when two `setState` calls run inside a `fetch().then(...)` callback?

options.text: React batches both updates into a single re-render

questions.prompt: Select all accessibility practices for custom modals/dialogs in React. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Remove all focus outlines with `outline: none`
Move focus into the dialog on open and restore focus to the trigger on close

questions.prompt: What does `useEffect(() => { ... }, [options])` suffer from if the caller passes an inline object `options={{ limit: 10 }}`?

options.text: A new object reference is created every render, causing the effect to re-run on every render

questions.prompt: What is a 'tearing' bug in concurrent UI rendering?

options.text: Different parts of the UI showing inconsistent values from the same external store during one render

questions.prompt: Why is `NODE_ENV=production` critical when deploying a React build?

options.text: It strips development-only warnings, prop/hook checks, and enables minification for much faster runtime performance

questions.prompt: How should you handle a component that needs to measure a DOM element's height after it renders?

options.text: Measure inside `useLayoutEffect` (or a ref callback) after DOM commit

questions.prompt: Match each React DevTools Profiler finding to its fix.

rows.label: Whole list re-renders when typing in a search box
Expensive sort/filter runs on unrelated state toggle
Heavy chart library loads on login page

columns.label: Colocate search input state or memoize list subtree

questions.prompt: What does colocating state ('keeping state as close as possible to where it is used') improve?

options.text: Reduces the number of components that re-render when that state changes

questions.prompt: Select all valid ways to prevent XSS when rendering user-supplied URLs in `<a href={url}>` in React. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Render `url` directly without checking protocol because React blocks `javascript:` hrefs in all versions
Parse with `new URL(input, window.location.origin)` and check `parsed.protocol`
Validate that `url` uses an allowed protocol such as `https:` or `http:` (or relative `/`) before rendering

questions.prompt: What does `useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({ focus, reset }), [])` allow a component to do?

options.text: Expose only a controlled, minimal imperative API (`focus`, `reset`) to parent refs instead of the raw DOM node

questions.prompt: Why should you avoid defining a component function *inside* another component's render body?

options.text: A new component function identity is created on every render, causing React to unmount and remount it instead of updating
Hooks cannot be used in nested components

questions.prompt: What is the role of React Server Components (RSC) in frameworks like Next.js?

options.text: They render on the server only, keeping heavy server dependencies and DB queries out of the client JS bundle

questions.prompt: Why can't a React Server Component directly call `useState` or `useEffect`?

options.text: Server Components have no browser lifecycle or interactive client state; interactive parts use `'use client'` boundaries

questions.prompt: Select all statements that are true about React production error monitoring. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Error Boundaries can report component stack traces to a logging service
Source maps help translate minified stack traces back to original source lines
Keep private source maps off public CDN endpoints if source shouldn't be exposed
Production errors never happen if TypeScript compiles

questions.prompt: What does `startTransition(() => setTab('posts'))` guarantee if the user clicks `'comments'` before `'posts'` finishes rendering?

options.text: React interrupts the stale `'posts'` transition render and switches to `'comments'`

questions.prompt: When integrating a third-party imperative library (like a chart or map widget) in React, what is the standard pattern?

options.text: Create and clean up the widget instance inside `useEffect` attached to a `ref` container

questions.prompt: What does `react-dom/client`'s `hydrateRoot(container, <App />)` do?

options.text: Attaches React event listeners and state to existing server-rendered HTML without re-creating DOM nodes
